explain.say: Here are kind things. Things to say: Are you okay? Can I help? I am here. Things to do: sit nearby, get a grown-up, give space, listen. Zara feels cared for. Well done! Your challenge: pick one kind thing to remember.

faq.q: How can I tell someone is upset?
faq.a: Look for clues: tears, a sad or cross face, sitting alone, or being very quiet. If you are not sure, you can ask, Are you okay?

faq.q: What can I say to someone who is upset?
faq.a: You can say, Are you okay? or Can I help? or I am here. Then listen to what they say.
asks: Tell me about Are you okay?
Tell me about Things to say

faq.q: When should I get a grown-up?
faq.a: Get a grown-up if someone is hurt, very upset, or if you do not know what to do. A grown-up you trust can help.
asks: Tell me about Get a grown-up

faq.q: What if they want to be left alone?
faq.a: That is okay. Some people need space. You can say, I am here if you need me, and tell a grown-up.

faq.q: Is it my job to fix their feelings?
faq.a: No. You cannot always fix feelings. Being kind and getting a grown-up is enough.
asks: Do I have to fix it?

facts: Tears, a sad face and sitting alone can be signs that someone is upset.
Asking Are you okay? is a simple way to show you care.

quiz.say: Your friend is crying. What can you say?
quiz.show: Your friend is crying. What can you say?
quiz.why: Are you okay? shows you care, and lets them tell you how they feel.

wrong.1: Telling them to stop can make them feel worse.

quiz.say: Someone is very upset and you do not know what to do. What helps?
quiz.show: You do not know what to do. What helps?
quiz.why: A grown-up can help when feelings are big.

wrong.2: Laughing can make them feel worse.
